notes: Matching per prompt_align.md (strict) against outputs/perdoc_merged_sonnet.json (nodes and edges only; evidence and merge_log ignored). Kela caseworker and Kela system are treated as the same actor; every actor difference is recorded in match_type_note. Citizen/landlord vs Kela counterparts of the same exchange are not matched (e.g. N020/G13, N021/G11). 'exact' = the node(s) are the same unit of work (possibly split over sub-step nodes); 'merged' = the primary node also covers another reference step; 'partial' = the node(s) cover only part of the step. multi_doc = the first matched node's confidence is >= 0.90 (merge rule R4: nodes supported by two or more source documents). order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists, in reference step order, where both steps are matched; each step is represented by its first-listed matched node (generated_pair); pairs mapping to the same node are skipped (listed in summary); the first 60 remaining pairs are checked. forward_len/reverse_len are shortest directed path lengths (edges) over all generated edges, including loop-backs; same_order is true only when a forward path exists and is no longer than the reverse path, false otherwise, 'not_connected' when no path exists in either direction.
